title: ITU-T H.872 Game Audio
summary: Game output scaling guidance from the ITU safe-listening recommendation.
descriptionMarkdown: Apply this Profile to a representative 30-minute gameplay measurement. PLVS cannot choose or validate that representative interval, so a whole-file result only maps directly when the analysed file is the intended test window. H.872 contains additional safe-listening features beyond output scaling; passing these loudness rules does not establish complete H.872 conformity.

references.title: ITU-T H.872 Safe Listening for Video Gameplay and Esports
references.relevanceMarkdown: Clause 9.3.1 defines the representative gameplay measurement window, output-scaling band and True Peak ceiling represented by this Profile.

releases.notesMarkdown: Initial curated release based on ITU-T H.872 output-scaling guidance.
